---
name: Tried it
about: You ran Clip Anything on a recording. Three quick answers help more than anything.
title: "Tried it: <game or kind of recording>"
labels: feedback
---

**1. What did you run it on?** (game, how it was recorded: PS5/Xbox clips, OBS, capture card, phone, VOD; length; OS)

**2. Out of the clips it made, how many would you post as-is, and how many were duds?** (a dud = menu, loading screen, nothing happening)

**3. What was the one thing that annoyed you?** (install, speed, a bad cut, captions, the crop, anything)

Optional: attach `clips/report.json` (it has no personal data, only times and scores) and the time the run took.
